17574.transcript:
Live Music Fridays at Black Powder Tavern

Join us every Friday night from 5:30 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. for live music in our Bar area. Musical acts will vary. See September’s schedule below.

September 4: Kate Buck

September 11: Joe Miralles

September 18: Brian Saunders

September 25: Brian Horoho

We look forward to seeing everyone for live music, great food and handcrafted cocktails.

Historical Dinner Series

We’re excited to continue our Historical Dinner Series at Black Powder Tavern!

Join us on the third Tuesday of every month as we learn about the American Revolution from guest speakers and enjoy dishes reminiscent of those served during Colonial Times.

This series is possible through a partnership with the Paoli Battlefield Preservation Fund.

Learn more about each month’s topic and reserve your spot. Our next lecture will take place on Tuesday, September 15, and is titled “How The Colonies Won The Revolution”. Lecturer Arch Hunter will explore the often-overlooked factors that led to America’s victory in the Revolutionary War. Discover how the colonies challenged the world’s leading superpower despite lacking a standing military, navy, weapons, and trained officers, and learn about the key people, battles, and international alliances that helped secure American independence.

Please arrive by 5:15 p.m. as dinner will be served around 5:45 p.m. View the special buffet dinner menu here.

We look forward to you joining us!

An End-of-Summer Seafood Celebration!

Join us for our End-of-The Summer Seafood Festival! From Friday, September 11 through Sunday, September 20, enjoy specially crafted lunch and dinner specials featuring fresh seafood favorites and seasonal flavors. View Lunch Specials View Dinner Specials Come celebrate the final days of summer and enjoy a delicious send-off to the season!

Happy Hour at Black Powder Tavern

We invite you to come and join us to celebrate Happy Hour on Tuesday through Friday from 4:00 p.m. until 6:00 p.m. You can enjoy the Black Powder Tavern experience with our special offers on drinks and Bar Bites.
